the coefficient of friction and the specific wear rate decreases with the increase of the graphite and Si C, TiO2 powder percentage in the glass-epoxy composite.
the wear rate decreases with the increase of the graphite and SiCs TiO2 particle percentage.

the effect of the addition of graphite and Si C, TiO2 powder on the tribological performance of unidirectional glass-epoxy composite in dry sliding condition.
the development of new materials for use as a tribological material in engineering applications.
the tribological behavior of graphite, SiC, Ti02 filled the unidirectional composite.

the graphite and SiCs, TiO2 filled composite shows better wear resistance and low coefficient of friction compared to the neat composite.
the wear rate of glass epoxy composites filled with Gr, SiCTiO2 powder decreases with increasing the load and velocity.
the graphite and SiO2 filled composite specimens show the best tribological properties compared to the other specimens in the present work.
